# Code Anchors: Pipeline Store Exclusion

- `libs/workspace/src/pipeline-stores.ts` — the one definition, in the leaf workspace library: the closed member list of four stores with a reason per store, the git pathspec rendering every consumer appends to a diff, and the containment test.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/pipeline-stores.spec.ts` — pins that the set names all four stores, justifies each, excludes each entire, that no command body restates a member path, and that no body captures the set into a variable instead of substituting it on the diff line (#686)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the `excluded-stores` verb, and the combined-change-set verb that passes the same set through to every per-pull-request diff (#521)
- `libs/portable-tools/src/derive-entry-diff.ts` — the range reader, which withholds the set from every range entry's change set rather than writing paths inline.
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the conformance diff, which substitutes the exclusions on the diff line and states that the body may not list the paths (#686)
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the close-from-diff pass, filtered the same way, with the same ban on restating the set (#686)
- `components/commands/nxs.intake.md` — the landed-change diff and the refusal that reads it, both filtered through the same substitution (#686)
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — the behavioural diff, which asks the toolkit for the set rather than carrying its own list.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range.ts` — close's range derivation, which withholds the set from the range diff it stamps and refuses a range left empty.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/landed-change.ts` — the landed-change comparison, which withholds the set from both the reviewed and the landed change.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/range.spec.ts` — pins that a range whose only change is an initiative context is refused as empty.
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — the acceptance changed-file set, filtered through the same definition.
